outline.firstLine: Department of Health Care Services (DHCS): The single State Department responsible for administration of the federal Medicaid (referred to as Medi-Cal in Califo
CalOptima Health PACE Center: The location designated by CalOptima Health PACE at which Members shall receive PCP services.
Participant: An individual enrolled in the CalOptima Health PACE program.
Nurse: A person licensed by the California Board of Nursing as a Registered Nurse (RN) or Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN).
